task: T00 — Chuẩn hóa bằng chứng và mâu thuẫn (redo từ đầu)
constraints: R0 offline; chỉ đọc artifact trong input/ASTRA_CMP40HX_HANDOFF; không SSH, không MMIO/PCI, không can thiệp card
package_checksum: 88/88 OK via sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256 from input/
scope: Q1 display DP/DVI, Q2 missing-SM/128 CUDA, Q3 straps/PCI class/Device ID — 14 focused claims from primary sources

claims.target_question: Stored word at NV_FUSE_STATUS_OPT_DISPLAY (0x021C04) in archived dump
claims.claim: regs["3076"]=1 in fuse2.json corresponds to absolute address 0x21C04 (base 0x21000 + key 3076×4 = 0xC04)
claims.method: Direct JSON field read + offset arithmetic
claims.alternative_explanation: Value may be shadow/latch/processed rather than raw OTP cell; single stored read
claims.limitation: timestamp not derivable from mtime per plan; do not assume OTP
claims.next_discriminator: Re-read 0x21C04 read-only with timestamp + GPU UUID

claims.target_question: PCI class and Device ID from saved lspci
claims.claim: lspci reports "3D controller: NVIDIA Corporation TU106 [CMP 40HX] (rev a1)" at 0000:03:00.0; config bytes base class=03 sub-class=02
claims.method: Direct JSON read of saved lspci_vv and config hex
claims.alternative_explanation: Saved observation may be historical; timestamp unknown in file
claims.limitation: Saved observation may be historical; timestamp unknown in file
claims.next_discriminator: Re-read live BDF with timestamp under approved scope

claims.claim: cuDeviceGetCount reports 1 device at BDF 0000:03:00.0, compute capability 7.5, 34 multiprocessors
claims.method: Direct read of saved target findings
claims.alternative_explanation: Effective API topology after any firmware mask; not proof of physical TPC count

claims.claim: DRM maps CMP40HX to card1/renderD129; inventory contains no connectors under card1; DP-1 belongs to card0 (BDF 0000:04:00.0, different device)
claims.method: Direct read of saved target findings
claims.alternative_explanation: DRM absence ≠ silicon absent; could be driver/VBIOS/policy
claims.next_discriminator: Re-check DRM connectors live with timestamp

claims.target_question: Headless EGL render on CMP BDF
claims.claim: EGL clear/readback produced 16 expected pixels on CMP40HX pbuffer via CUDA BDF match; GL vendor NVIDIA, renderer NVIDIA CMP 40HX, OpenGL ES 3.2 615.71.09
claims.method: Direct read of saved target findings
claims.alternative_explanation: Bounded pbuffer/headless correctness; not physical scanout or DP/DVI output
claims.limitation: Context only; not a display-path discriminator
claims.next_discriminator: Physical output test tied to CMP connector

claims.target_question: VBIOS DCB connector entries reported as 0
claims.claim: Parser output from prior Codex Phase 21 states DCB connector entries=0 for CMP ROM
claims.method: Trusting prior parser output without independent re-run
claims.alternative_explanation: Parser version/offset may be wrong; independent re-parse required
claims.next_discriminator: Independent DCB parse with corrected pointer base (T05)

claims.claim: GenCAD lists STRAP0-5 → GPU pins BL3/BL4/BM4/BM5/BK5/BJ5; each net has 1V8_AON pull-up + GND pull-down footprints; CMP population UNKNOWN
claims.alternative_explanation: Netlist ≠ CMP BOM; population not confirmed
claims.limitation: Netlist is design intent, not CMP physical population
claims.next_discriminator: Continuity / resistance check on 12 footprints with power off

claims.claim: Prior analysis predicted R258/R249/R250 DNP and R261/R264/R265 SMD → STRAP[5:3]≈000
claims.alternative_explanation: Visual ID only; no resistance/continuity measurement; assumes CMP keeps GenCAD connectivity
claims.limitation: Photo resolution may be insufficient for 0402; no resistance/logic/latch measurement
claims.next_discriminator: Macro photo + resistance check with power off

claims.claim: Saved lspci shows class 0302 (3D controller); no evidence that class 0300 would enable DP/DVI output
claims.alternative_explanation: Class is enumeration metadata only; does not prove display capability
claims.limitation: Class value alone says nothing about DP/DVI output

claims.target_question: Archived early report 0x21C04=0 vs raw dump 1
claims.claim: EVIDENCE_CONTRADICTIONS.md lists an early report claiming 0x21C04=0 while raw fuse2.json has regs["3076"]=1
claims.locator: 0x21C04 row in contradictions table + fuse2.json regs["3076"]
claims.method: Direct comparison of two saved sources
claims.alternative_explanation: One or both captures may be wrong offset/endian/version
claims.limitation: Cannot determine which source is correct without re-read
claims.next_discriminator: Re-read 0x21C04 with verified offset and timestamp

claims.claim: Target reports driver and GSP 615.71.09; static analysis was done on 615.78.08
claims.alternative_explanation: Static 615.78.08 addresses may not map to 615.71.09
claims.limitation: Version mismatch between static analysis and runtime

claims.claim: README and decision tree state CUDA/3D already works but is not the question; physical scanout via DP/DVI unverified
claims.next_discriminator: Physical monitor output tied to CMP BDF

claims.alternative_explanation: Poison is a read-path result, not proof of transistor absence or laser cut

claims.claim: fuse2.json stats: words=3072, with_data=352, poison=2202, zero=518
claims.alternative_explanation: Metadata counts are not silicon health evidence
